title: The Frog Prince
text: A frog the size of a cat sits on a lily pad wearing a tiny crown, its throat swelling as it speaks. He begs to be kissed, very politely, with great dignity. He was a prince of the Drowned Marches once, he says, before he said something to the wrong witch.

options.label: The kindest kisses him, hoping to undo the witch's work.

outcomes.text: He becomes a prince, wet, grateful and naked. His House will remember the favor.
He remains a frog, a poisonous one, and he is very sorry about it.

options.label: Take his tiny crown. A frog has no need of gold.

outcomes.text: The gold is real. The frog is very angry, and he knows a witch whom he will tell.

options.label: Wish him luck, and go, before anyone is tempted.

outcomes.text: He croaks a very small curse after you. That night every waterskin in the party tastes of pond.

options.label: The kindly one kisses him, unable to leave anyone so cursed.

outcomes.text: He is a prince just long enough to press a ring into their hand, then a frog again, weeping.
Nothing happens at all, save for the taste, which lasts.
